name: Validation Research Facility

triggers.label: Step onto Coordinate Translocator
triggers.tooltip: Activate the arcane relocation grid to teleport to Test Hub (1, 1).
triggers.description: A glowing circle of runes inlaid into the polished obsidian floor.

triggers.label: Biomantic Transformation Chamber
triggers.tooltip: Enter the interactive transformation chamber or apply direct mutations/gestation.
triggers.description: An alchemical cylinder filled with glowing biomantic nutrient fluids.

triggers.label: Arcane Infusion Altar
triggers.tooltip: Open the enchanting altar UI, stage infusions, and craft enchanted gear.
triggers.description: A raised granite pedestal inscribed with glowing runic conduits.

defaultDescriptions: You are inside the Validation Research Facility. Polished stone and brass conduit lines snake across high vaulted ceilings.
Humming alchemical arrays and arcane measurement instruments monitor engine parameters throughout the secure chamber.

1,1: You stand near the heavy exit bulkhead leading back out to the Proving Grounds.
The airlock threshold is marked with yellow hazard bands and pressure release valves.
2,2: You stand before the central coordinate translocator pad. Pulsing azure light ripples across the floor glyphs.
The translocation array hums softly, waiting for destination coordinates.
3,1: The Biomantic Transformation Chamber hums with cellular realignment energies.
Sensors and containment glass enclose the transmutation platform.
1,3: The Arcane Infusion Altar glows with concentrated magical essence.
Chiseled channels guide enchanting power into staged equipment.
3,3: The Facility Storage Vault is reinforced with warding sigils, keeping stored goods perfectly safe.
Secure metallic lockers and chests line the wall.

bookshelf_corner: Cabinets of laboratory research scrolls and calibration sheets.
Indexed filing cabinets containing system logs.
kitchenette: A coffee and ration preparation station for laboratory staff.
Clean ceramic counters and thermal heating plates.
hearth: An alchemical hearth providing stable thermal regulation.
Warm ventilation ducts keeping the research floor temperate.
